verified_source_contracts.claim: onSessionId appends an observer, immediately invokes it with an existing _sessionId/_windowId, and returns unsubscribe. It does not allocate a session ID.
Public onSessionId delegates to the existing session manager, returning a noop unsubscribe when absent.
sessionRecordingStarted returns the boolean state of sessionRecording.started without starting or changing it.
The started getter reads the lazy recorder's isStarted.
The recorder submits $snapshot through the normal instance.capture path with a Replay endpoint and batch key.
capture runs _runBeforeSend on event data; null drops the event, otherwise it continues with that returned value.
_runBeforeSend invokes configured hooks in order and honors null. The application still returns its existing sanitizer's result unchanged after observing only event name/session ID.
get_session_id delegates to checkAndGetSessionAndWindowId(true); the patch does not call it, relying on naturally observed IDs.

upload_acknowledgement.reason: No inspected public response contract reliably binds a /s/ acknowledgement to the current opaque session without reading body. A response merely close in time is not used as proof.

test_scope: Real installed SDK sources and declaration compatibility; fake SDK/DOM unit fixtures execute the actual bridge/serialized actor callback. No real browser recorder or upstream ingestion was exercised.
